decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper sits close to the established dumper range and shares engineering, parts and service, so it costs little to keep open while its demand is still resolving after only two years.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant and niche, and two years of long-cycle mining demand still reveal too little about its value to justify giving up an option that builds on the firm's underground expertise.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is close to the core business, keeps several growth options open, and shows no sign that its value will fail to materialize.
The material lift line is described as the most popular in the rental market and just won a large order, so its value is largely confirmed and it merits further commitment.
Although the underground loader is distant from the core offer, 1,000 operating hours in seven months is strong early field evidence that favors keeping and developing it.
